reasoning_traces.think:
The homepage functions as a dynamic decision architecture integrating semantic affordances into a probabilistic belief system. Each section contributes an affordance strength A(s), which is aggregated into an intent vector I(t). This vector evolves under a Bayesian update rule, where prior beliefs are refined by observed user behavior. The trust-risk balance B(T,R) acts as a scalar utility function that modulates the influence of each affordance on downstream actions. The GSE interprets these dynamics as a Markov process over user states, where transitions depend on the current value of B(T,R) and the entropy of I(t). Failure modes include overfitting to early clicks, underweighting of trust signals, and collapse of I(t) into deterministic attractors. The system must maintain a balance between exploration and exploitation while ensuring that all transformations remain within the bounds of empirical observability.
